elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 expressly states that Customer may engage any supplier and has made no exclusivity commitment; the conflicting disclose-and-match restriction in former Section 7.2 is absent.

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity applies at all, which is more protective than category-limited exclusivity.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity applies, so there is no exclusivity period exceeding 12 months.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: Because Customer has no exclusivity obligation, no exclusivity can persist following a service-level failure.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: Because Customer has no exclusivity obligation, no exclusivity can persist following a delivery-date failure.
